ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud Case: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including those involved, the methods used, and the impact on Minnesota’s food assistance programs.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify key players
questions: What were the methods used for fraud?
What is the impact on Minnesota’s food assistance programs?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant fraud scheme within Minnesota’s food assistance programs, potentially leading to further investigations and policy changes.

ideas.title: Uncovering Medicare Fraud: A Widespread Issue
ideas.description: Explore the recent freeze on Medicare enrollments for new home healthcare and hospice providers and its implications for the healthcare sector.
ideas.angle: Investigate the extent of Medicare fraud
questions: What are the common practices among fraudulent healthcare providers?
What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a significant issue within the healthcare sector, leading to increased scrutiny and potential policy changes.
